Several measurement analyses can share one physical native job. All actual netlist/log/PSF paths and per-file hashes remain in the machine-readable GUI results JSON. This source project also includes a build manifest recording the local figure hashes.

Scope: nominal schematic-level NCSU devices and ideal external sources. Layout parasitics, process corners, Monte Carlo, and LO-driver noise/power are outside this comparison.
